description: This file implements functions for managing and calculating average values within a table structure, primarily used for performance or telemetry data in firmware. It includes functions to fill, reset, add values, retrieve specific values by indexes or parameters, and get count of values in a table.

methods.name: avgFill
methods.description: Fills the entire AvgTable with specified count and value.

methods.name: avgReset
methods.description: Resets the table to zero counts and values.

methods.name: avgAddValue
methods.description: Adds a value to the table at position corresponding to rpm and key.

methods.name: avgGetValueByIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves the average value from the table at specified indexes.

methods.name: avgGetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the average value based on rpm and key parameters.

methods.name: avgGetValuesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of values added at the specified rpm and key.
